title: DetectionRaisedPayload
description: Payload for event_type=detection.raised, schema_version major=1. Emitted by the Elastic Defend / Suricata adapters (Step 7). The detection adapter never steers — this event carries no routing/target information.

correlation_key.description: Deterministic key used to correlate related detections into one case (host + rule family + time-window derived).

source_refs.description: References to the raw Elastic/Suricata source documents (index+doc id), never the raw payload itself.
